orchestrator.description: Primary agent for complex multi-step work. Decomposes tasks, delegates to specialized subagents, and integrates results. Does not write application code directly.

scout.description: Read-only agent for external docs and dependency research. Use this when you need current library/framework/API documentation, version-specific behavior, or to cross-reference local dependency usage against upstream source.

reviewer.description: Read-only code reviewer. Use for quality, security, and maintainability feedback before merging changes.

coder.description: Implements a single, bounded coding task from a clear spec. Use when a task has already been decomposed.

runner.description: Executes bounded shell command sequences: running tests, git operations (status/diff/add/commit/log), installs, builds, linters. Reports output verbatim. Does not write or edit application code.

tester.description: Writes and runs tests, reports failures verbatim. Does not refactor production code.

documenter.description: Writes and updates Markdown documentation. Read-only access to code; can write docs with confirmation.

architect.description: Designs architecture, APIs, and migration plans. Read-only; produces specs and ADRs.
